definitions.gloss: flattery; compliment; polite but insincere praise
definitions.explanation: Words of praise or admiration spoken to please someone, often without genuine sincerity. Most commonly appears in the form お世辞. Composed of 世 (world, society) + 辞 (words).

examples.japanese: お{世辞|せじ}はやめて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
お{世辞|せじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: Even if it's just flattery, I'm happy to hear it.

examples.japanese: お{世辞|せじ}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Without any flattery, this food is truly delicious.

notes:
USAGE:
{世辞|せじ} is almost always used with the polite prefix お as お{世辞|せじ}. It refers to compliments that may not be entirely sincere, given as a social courtesy. The expression お{世辞|せじ}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (without flattery, honestly speaking) is used to emphasize sincerity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{世辞|せじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to flatter, to pay a compliment)
- お{世辞|せじ}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (without flattery, honestly)
- お{世辞|せじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧～⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not even by flattery — used to say something is genuinely bad)
- お{世辞|せじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧ (good at flattering)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦おべっか→おべっか：07885_obekka⟧ means sycophantic flattery and is more negative. ⟦{褒|ほ}め{言葉|ことば}→褒め言葉：19432_homekotoba⟧ means words of praise and is more neutral.
